classifications: Theory of computation → Dynamic graph algorithms
statement: ▶ Problem 1. Does there exist a fully dynamic (∆ + 1)-coloring with o(n2/3 ) update time that remains robust against adaptive adversaries?
context: To reduce the number of colors to ∆ + 1, the approach of [13, 19, 1, 8, 4] and ours is to compute a partial coloring in which (sparse) vertices have many pairs of neighbors colored the same. The randomized argument underlying this approach is fragile, requiring a complete rerun every Θ(∆) update. Since it is based on random color trials at every vertex, it runs in O(n2 /∆) time. Amortized and balanced with the O(∆) update time for small ∆, we obtain the n2/3 update time. ▶ Problem 1.
